name: 87-corocotta
description: Corocotta: a cross of hyena and wolf, grey-steel fur, dark bristling mane along its sloping back, snarling jaws with a single great unbroken tooth in each jaw, yellow eyes. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Standing in place: its dark mane bristles up along its back, then it throws its jaws wide open on its two great teeth as if speaking, then closes them. Feet planted, same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
